newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares end lower in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares end lower in continuous trade.

text.p: Three stocks fell, one rose and four were flat in Warsaw bourse 1.7 million-zloty continuous trade on Tuesday.
The remaining seven stocks did not trade.
NFI units were flat in a 32.1-million-zloty turnover.
The continuous trading system, which currently lists 15 companies, is separate from the bourse's main single-price auction system in which the same firms and 65 others are traded.
At the single-price auction session the main market's index rose 0.4 percent.
